_comment: Speckzettel product catalog. Keys are ingredient names (German, shown to users; singular unless bought in plural). group: shop section (see groups, in shop-walk order). area: where it is usually kept. unit: unit of the pack. tracking: exact / rough / flag. profile: perishable (shelf-life clock) or stable (no clock); the freezer always counts as frozen. shelfDays: days from purchase (perishable only). openedDays: days after opening (also turns stable into perishable). graceDays: days 'drüber' after expiry before 'vermutlich weg' (default: same as shelfDays). useBy: use-by date (meat, fish): grace 0, 'nicht mehr essen'. pack: usual pack size in unit. diet: vegan / vegetarian / all. staple: always there (Salz, Pfeffer, Wasser). snack: only tracked if the household turns snacks on. ignore: not taken over from receipts by default. icon: own symbol (else the group's). loose: sold loose, on the shopping list in pieces (per.Stück as the average) unless the variety is in packedVarieties. strictVariety: true = another variety is only offered as a swap in recipes; a list = only these varieties are kept apart. varietyGroups: {group variety: member varieties}; asking for the group takes any member. family: entries that stand in for each other in recipes (Milch / H-Milch / Pflanzendrink), if the pack's diet is at least as strict.sizes: usual pack sizes to pick from when buying. plural: display plural. per: {unit: amount in this ingredient's unit}. synonyms: other names, 'text|Sorte' sets the variety. receiptRules: case-insensitive regex patterns, tried in order (longest first).
